title: Ruleset hardening: promote five low-risk rules to Error
summary: Five diagnostic rules are promoted from Warning to Error level in the ruleset by removing global overrides and fixing the underlying issues in affected application objects across multiple localization layers.
key_points: Five rules (AL0254, AL0523, AA0242, AA0224, AW0007) are promoted from Warning to Error in the base ruleset
Developers must fix or suppress actionable findings in 52 affected application files
Real fixes added for recursion, option-model/caption, partial-record, and missing-key issues
Global warning overrides reduced from 81 to 76 in base.ruleset.json
Tightly scoped ID-qualified suppressions retained for accepted pre-existing behavior
